description: The audio of eac3-signal-compr (the frames of eac3-signal-spx 18 dB quieter) with compre set and a compr word of 0 dB (0x00) in the first six frames and compre 0 in the last six, dialnorm 27: to see whether a decoder that picks its output mode by the presence of compr changes its gain at the step, with no compr gain to confuse the steps.
